aboutGame.title: What is +1 Wings For Eggs?
paragraphs: +1 Wings For Eggs is a free-to-play flight and egg-collection tycoon on Roblox from developer Crazay Art. You take to the sky, fly to distant nests and areas, steal Eggs, and bring them back to your Base to hatch Animals that keep earning Cash even while you are offline.

Progress runs on one simple loop: spend Cash on stronger Wings, Flight Speed, and Base capacity so you can reach farther areas with rarer Eggs and better Animals, then Rebirth for a permanent Cash multiplier. Our wiki maps every system with guides, tier lists, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common +1 Wings For Eggs questions about Eggs, Animals, Wings, Cash, codes, and Rebirth.

items.question: What is +1 Wings For Eggs?
items.answer: +1 Wings For Eggs is a free-to-play flight and egg-collection tycoon on Roblox from developer Crazay Art. You fly to distant nests, steal Eggs, hatch Animals, earn Cash, upgrade your Wings, and Rebirth to reach farther areas.

items.question: How do I get more Eggs in +1 Wings For Eggs?
items.answer: Fly to farther areas, grab the Eggs that spawn there, and carry them back to your Base before your Wing Stamina runs out. Stronger Wings and Flight Speed upgrades let you reach the rarer Eggs that appear in distant nests.

items.question: Which Animals should I keep in +1 Wings For Eggs?
items.answer: Keep the highest-rarity Animals you can hatch, because they earn the most Cash and keep paying while you are offline. Sell or hatch duplicates to fund better Eggs and stronger Wing upgrades.

items.question: How do codes work in +1 Wings For Eggs?
items.answer: Codes are short, time-limited strings that grant free rewards such as Cash, Eggs, spins, or cosmetic Wings. Redeem them in the in-game codes menu as soon as they drop, since most expire quickly and only work once per account.

items.question: When should I Rebirth in +1 Wings For Eggs?
items.answer: Rebirth when your Cash income has slowed and the permanent multiplier will clearly beat what you would earn by staying. Rebirth resets your current run but grants a lasting Cash boost that makes every future run faster.
